en.title: Build Monuments
en.description:
Assign each node of a tree one of k types, so that cities that are directly connected or share a neighbor do not have the same type. The company source is marked Unknown on OAMaster; this site adds the input protocol and constraints.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: The first line contains k n (1≤k≤10^9, 1≤n≤10^5); each of the next n−1 lines is an undirected edge u v, with cities numbered 1..n. The input is guaranteed to form a tree.
en.output: Output the number of assignments in which any two cities at distance at most 2 have different types, modulo 1,000,000,007. This site adds this standard input protocol and the constraints.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: Root the tree at city 1; children of the same node are also at distance 2 from each other.
